```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```
Reading the breeding site CSV file
```{r}
bird_breeding_sites <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(bird_breeding_sites)
```
Viewing just the column names
```{r}
colnames(bird_breeding_sites)
```

Seeing a summary of the data
```{r}
glimpse(bird_breeding_sites)
```
Migratory connectivty data
```{r}
bird_migratory_connectivity <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(bird_migratory_connectivity))
```

Inspecting the file
```{r}
glimpse(bird_migratory_connectivity)

print(dim(bird_migratory_connectivity))
```

Include code
```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```

Select, de-deduplicate and rename
```{r}
bird_migration_selected <- bird_migratory_connectivity |>
  select(
    Site,
    winterLongitude,
    winterLatitude,
    pslon,
    pslat,
    iblon,
    iblat,
    awestlon,
    awestlat
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(
    Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude,
    Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude,
    Stopover_Longitude = pslon,
    Stopover_Latitude = pslat,
    Iberian_Longitude = iblon,
    Iberian_Latitude = iblat,
    Westmost_Longitude = awestlon,
    Westmost_Latitude = awestlat
  )

gt(bird_migration_selected)
```

Filtering a data frame
```{r}
bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)

bird_migration_exc <- bird_migration_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(bird_migration_exc)
```
Grouping data
```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)
glimpse(bird_migration_grouped)

```
Using grouped data
```{r}
bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Stopover_Latitude = median(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Stopover_Longitude = median(Stopover_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Latitude = median(Iberian_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Longitude = median(Iberian_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Latitude = median(Westmost_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Longitude = median(Westmost_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Latitude = median(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Longitude = median(Winter_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

gt(bird_migration_summary)
```

Joins
```{r}
combined_bird_data <- full_join(bird_breeding_exc, bird_migration_summary)

gt(combined_bird_data)
```

Converting from wide to long format 
```{r}
combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_bird_piv)
```

Subset data
```{r}
spring_vals <- c("Breeding", "Stopover", "Winter")
autumn_vals <- c("Breeding", "Iberian", "Westmost", "Winter")

spring_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% spring_vals)

gt(spring_data)

autumn_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% autumn_vals)

gt(autumn_data)
```

Converting data into a CSV and placing it in the output file
```{r}
write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")
```

Making a plot
```{r}
ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x=Longitude,y=Latitude)
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude)
) +
  geom_point()
```
Putting the information on a map
```{r}
ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude)
) +
  geom_point() +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap()
```
Calculating min/max lat/long
```{r}
min_long <- spring_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min()

print(paste("minimum longitude", min_long))
      
max_long <- spring_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max()

print(paste("maximum longitude", max_long))
      
min_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min()

print(paste("minimum latitude", min_lat))

max_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max()

print(paste("maximum latitude", max_lat))

      
      
```
```{r}
ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, 
      y = Latitude, 
      colour = Site, 
      shape = Location_Type)
) + 
  geom_point(size=3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) + 
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(min_long - 2, max_long + 2), 
                 ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat + 2)
) +
  geom_path(aes(group=Site))
  ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Spring Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
Autumn Data
```{r}
amin_lon <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min()

amax_lon <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max()

amin_lat <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min()

amax_lat <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max()

ggplot(
  autumn_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, 
      y = Latitude, 
      colour = Site,
      shape = Location_Type)
  ) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(amin_lon - 2, amax_lon + 2),
                 ylim = c(amin_lat - 2, amax_lat +2)) + 
  geom_path(aes(group=Site)) +
  ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Autumn Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
